flow previsit.outreach v1
title: Pre-visit outreach
start: cycle
stage previsit: Before the visit
step cycle [Repetition] Reminder round
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Repeats up to 3 times.
  body: For each round: go to Check what is missing
  onExhausted: If the rounds run out: go to Final front desk follow-up
step check [Read] Check what is missing
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Reads information from `intake.requirements`. It sends `case_ref`. It keeps `missing`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 3 attempts in all.
  next: When it succeeds: go to Decide on a reminder
  onError: If it fails: go to Front desk follow-up
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Final front desk follow-up
step assess [Decision] Decide on a reminder
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Judges with the rule `previsit.missing_items` using `missing`. The result field `action` says where the process goes.
  on:none: If `action` is `none`: go to Ready for the visit
  on:some: If `action` is `some`: go to Send reminder
  onNoDecision: If the rule gives no result: go to Front desk follow-up
  onError: If the rule cannot be applied: go to Front desk follow-up
step send [Action] Send reminder
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Asks `messaging.reminder` to do something. It contacts a person. It is never sent twice. It only goes out inside the delivery window Contact hours. It sends `case_ref` and `missing`. If the call fails for a passing reason it tries again, up to 3 attempts in all.
  next: When it succeeds: go to Wait for the reply
  onError: If it fails: go to Front desk follow-up
  onNotAvailable: If the connection is not available: go to Final front desk follow-up
  onNotEntitled: If the plan does not include it: go to Final front desk follow-up
  onUnknown: If it is not known whether it went out: go to Front desk follow-up
step reply [Wait for an event] Wait for the reply
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Waits for the event `case.reply_received`. Only the event that carries the same `case_ref` counts.
  next: When the event arrives: go to Reminder round
  onTimeout: If no answer arrives within 1 day: go to Reminder round
step escalate [Task for a person] Front desk follow-up
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Front desk. A person chooses Resolved or Unreachable. The person sees `case_ref` and `missing`.
  on:resolved: If the person chooses Resolved: go to Reminder round
  on:unreachable: If the person chooses Unreachable: go to Case unreachable
  onTimeout: If no answer arrives within 3 days: go to Case unreachable
step escalate_final [Task for a person] Final front desk follow-up
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Gives a task to the queue Front desk. A person chooses Resolved or Unreachable. The person sees `case_ref` and `missing`.
  on:resolved: If the person chooses Resolved: go to Ready for the visit
  on:unreachable: If the person chooses Unreachable: go to Case unreachable
  onTimeout: If no answer arrives within 3 days: go to Case unreachable
step done [End] Ready for the visit
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Ready.
step closed [End] Case unreachable
  stage: Before the visit
  does: Ends the case with the result Unreachable.
